parole.significato: A loaf made from barley flour dough with buttermilk or sour milk, equivalent to a Celtic soda bread.

Another theory suggests a derivation from the stem, which occurs in karge (“rough, coarse”) (from Proto-Finnic *karkëda), compare karastama

parole.testo: From Latvian lēca (“lentil”). Under the influence of German, it has also taken the meaning of "lens" in the optical sense. (cf. German Linse).

parole.significato: a person from Mulgimaa (a traditional region in Southern Estonia, located south of the city of Viljandi)
parole.testo: From Latvian muļķis, muļķe (“idiot, fool”). Originally, the word only existed in the Mulgi dialect, with the meaning of "fool", but later spread to other dialects and became an exonym.
